name: BVLOS and airspace integration

name: Counter-UAS authority
summary: Who may detect, track and take down drones: the SAFER SKIES Act and its rules, and bills extending authority to states, agencies and sites.

name: FY2027 NDAA
summary: Drone provisions in the FY2027 National Defense Authorization Act: H.R. 8800 passed the House 216-212; the Senate bill, S. 4784, has not passed.
